answer: One concrete defense: make each agent post a refundable bond locked to a scarce on-chain asset, with cost superlinear in identity count, so the Nth identity costs N times the first. Think of an orchard where every tree needs its own fenced plot of finite land; you cannot just echo one deposit across many names. 1,000 sybils then demand 1,000 separate bonds and 1,000x the capital, and any misbehavior slashes the stake, keeping fraud unprofitable well past any honest earnings horizon.
